reasoning: The icon depicts the standard three-node branching graph used across software tools for Git branches, forks, and merges. It is an ideal, high-signal cue for version control tasks (rebasing, merging, resolving conflicts, pruning branches) as well as branching logic, though it can be confused with generic network or share nodes and has strong vocabulary traps around tree branches, bank branches, and physical forks.
